components.name: Chat
components.description: A chat window: an optional header bar, a conversation that keeps each new turn in view while replies stream in, a shimmering status line, and a composer with file attachments. Built on Message Scroller, Message, Bubble, Attachment and Marker; the app owns the messages and the sending.

props.name: label
props.description: Title in the header bar. Leave it out to hide the bar.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content at the end of the header bar, e.g. a New chat button.

props.name: background
props.description: Layers painted behind the conversation, e.g. a Gradient or Noise.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown in the middle while there are no messages.

props.name: pending
props.description: Shows a shimmering status line under the last message.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the trimmed text and picked files. The box clears after.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Adds a paperclip button that picks files to send with the message.

props.name: hint
props.description: Note under the composer.

props.name: showAvatars
props.description: Avatars beside other people's messages.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Prompts shown as chips while there are no messages; a click sends one.

props.name: followUps
props.description: Chips above the composer once the conversation has started; a click sends one.

props.name: tools
props.description: Controls in the composer bar before the Send button, e.g. a model picker or mic.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Copy button under assistant replies. On by default.

props.name: onRegenerate
props.description: Adds a Regenerate button under the last assistant reply.

props.name: replyBubble
props.description: Bubble style for replies from others. `speech` draws a tailed speech bubble.

components.name: SideChat
components.description: A support-style chat docked to a corner: a round launcher that opens a floating Chat panel above it, with a close button in the header bar. Escape closes it. Takes every Chat prop.

props.name: position
props.description: `fixed` pins to the viewport, like a support widget. `absolute` pins to the nearest positioned parent, for previews inside a page.

props.name: panelClassName
props.description: Classes for the panel that holds the chat.
